errors.text_span: 蓝色的柱状图代表每日新增患者人数
errors.evidence: The bar chart represents the number of new patients, but its color is teal/blue-green, not blue. The line chart is blue. This description incorrectly assigns the color blue to the bar chart, creating confusion.

The description uses the axis labels ("每日新增患者人数" and "每日新闻报道数目") to describe the data series, but omits the more specific information provided in the legend ("该日全球确诊数量" - Global confirmed cases on that day, and "有关covid-19新闻数量" - Number of news about covid-19).

errors.text_span: 蓝色用于表示每日新增患者人数
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly maps the color blue to the patient number data series (the bars). The bars are teal/blue-green, while the line chart is blue.
